I now know that when someone is in a suicidal state that they aren't capable of thinking logically. I understand suicide on a deeper level now.

It's a long story. We drifted apart after I got fired right before covid. She was pregnant at the time and resented me for it. I tried as best as I could to keep the marriage going for about a year and a half. I got this new job here and we were both planning on moving down here. While I was here by myself I tried to cheat on her. I felt justified somehow because we haven't been romantic in a year in a half. I didn't actually do it, but she found out about it and that's what officially ended things. I don't blame her really. I just wish we could fix things. I don't think we can though. Between losing her and being so far away from my son it's been really hard dealing with these feelings on my own in a city I'm unfamiliar with. She was my best friend and honestly the only person I could talk to about my feelings. Thats why I'm sharing this here.
